validation.label: Validate research question
acceptanceChecks: research question is bounded and falsifiable
acceptance criteria are measurable

literature.label: Survey relevant literature
acceptanceChecks: primary sources have stable identifiers
closest work and unresolved gaps are explicit
failureSignals: claims are not traceable to retrieved records

idea.label: Generate candidate ideas
acceptanceChecks: candidate ideas address the validated gap
selection names a testable mechanism
failureSignals: selected idea has no falsifiable mechanism

novelty.label: Check novelty
acceptanceChecks: novelty is compared against primary sources
differentiators are concrete and falsifiable

refine.label: Refine the method
acceptanceChecks: method directly addresses the selected problem
components and assumptions are implementation-ready

experiment-plan.label: Plan experiments
acceptanceChecks: every intended claim maps to evidence
run order has cheap failure gates
failureSignals: baselines or stopping criteria are missing

implement-solution.label: Implement the solution
acceptanceChecks: implementation and required runtime resources are reusable from the task resource root
behavioral tests cover the core method
failureSignals: runtime resource or test evidence is missing

run.label: Run experiments
acceptanceChecks: reported metrics are backed by run logs
failed runs remain visible

monitor.label: Monitor experiments
acceptanceChecks: health conclusions cite current logs
anomalies have explicit actions

result-to-claim.label: Map results to claims
acceptanceChecks: each claim names supporting result evidence
unsupported claims are explicitly withheld
scientific outcome and mission coverage match the primary research objective
failureSignals: negative or inconclusive results are omitted

paper-plan.label: Plan the paper
acceptanceChecks: paper structure follows supported claims
figures and citations map to evidence

paper-write.label: Write the paper
acceptanceChecks: manuscript claims remain evidence-bound
citations have stable source refs
failureSignals: limitations or negative results are hidden

paper-compile.label: Compile the paper
acceptanceChecks: compiled artifact exists
build log and validation are retained
editable compilation sources and required local inputs are retained
page layout is checked and no text or tables are clipped

research-review.label: Review the research
acceptanceChecks: review checks the full claim-evidence chain
blocking weaknesses become explicit repairs
review independently confirms the scientific outcome and mission coverage
failureSignals: claim or citation audit is missing

acceptance: at least one claim is supported by reviewed evidence

acceptanceChecks: verified

task.objective: Independently audit this execution plan before any worker is dispatched. Assess planning adequacy, not whether the planned experiments have already succeeded.
acceptanceChecks: The plan advances the mission within its boundaries and addresses the current stage purpose
Task scopes are actionable, feasible within budgets, and do not duplicate or depend on concurrent outputs
Declared inputs provide the evidence needed for the proposed work and are current
Output fields and acceptance criteria can falsify an inadequate result rather than merely confirm execution
Local work has a coherent path to complete synthesis; complete deliveries cover the stage contract
The plan addresses outstanding repair and previous plan-review findings without weakening requirements
